# Research: win32job Rust crate — current published version

## Summary

The current published version of the `win32job` Rust crate is **2.0.3**, released on 2025-05-15, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, with 1,045,730 total downloads.

## Findings

1. **Version 2.0.3 is the latest** — published on 2025-05-15. Prior releases: 2.0.2 (2025-02-21), 2.0.1 (2025-01-23), 2.0.0 (2024-01-26), and earlier 1.x versions. [Source](https://crates.io/crates/win32job)
2. **Crate metadata** — safe Rust API for Windows Job Objects, maintained by ohadravid, repository at [ohadravid/win32job-rs](https://github.com/ohadravid/win32job-rs). Dependencies include `windows ^0.61` and `thiserror ^1.0`. [Source](https://docs.rs/crate/win32job/2.0.3)
3. **Usage** — 1,045,730 total downloads, 387,937 downloads in the last 90 days, and 14 reverse dependencies. [Source](https://lib.rs/crates/win32job)

## Sources

- **Kept**: https://crates.io/crates/win32job — official crates.io registry page, authoritative source for version and metadata.
- **Kept**: https://docs.rs/crate/win32job/2.0.3 — docs.rs page confirming version 2.0.3 release date and dependency tree.
- **Kept**: https://lib.rs/crates/win32job — lib.rs mirrors version and download data.
- **Kept**: https://github.com/ohadravid/win32job-rs — source repository, confirms ownership and API documentation.

## Gaps

None. All sources unanimously confirm version 2.0.3 as the latest published release.
